method: Temper spices and sauté onions, garlic, and chilies.
Add veg and water; cook until tender.
Add tamarind extract, salt, and cover to cook for 10 minutes.
Once vegetables are cooked, add the boiled chickpeas.
Add a handful of grated coconut and bring to a boil once.
Serve as a side for Chapathi and Idiyappam.
